record.title: Tamulpur orders selective Bhutan-border closure for April 2026 Assam polling
record.scope: Non-exempt movement of people and vehicles through Tamulpur’s Bhutan-border routes
record.crossings: International land entry/exit points in Tamulpur district, Assam
record.direction: Entry and exit, with category-specific exemptions
record.exceptions: Medical emergencies from Bhutan; Indian citizens/foreign tourists already in Bhutan with valid documents; permitted tourists travelling to Bhutan; essential perishable cargo after checks; identified Tamulpur and Goreshwar voters entering the district.
record.imposing_authority: Tamulpur District Magistrate and District Election Officer Simi Karan
record.enforcement: Two reports describe the district order; gate-level compliance not independently observed.
record.relationship: Separate Assam district order from the later April 20–23 West Bengal-related Bhutan gate measure R5-SC-005.
record.status_observation: Order effective April 6 at 17:00, scheduled through April 9 polling completion; operational reopening unverified.
record.official_rationale: Secure and orderly Assam Assembly polling and prevention of unlawful cross-border influence.
record.context: District-specific election measure with broad exceptions.
record.uncertainty: Signed order and operational reopening not retrieved. April 9 is scheduled polling completion; no exact closed-hours claim.
